# ADR-009: no synchronous third-party calls in request handlers

Decision: no third-party HTTP call may run inside a request handler. Use the outbox (app/outbox.py) and a worker.

Context: in 2021 a 30 s tax-provider outage stalled every checkout request for 30 s and took the site down. The fraud check was moved to the outbox for the same reason.
